summary: Comprehensive backend (pytest, 28 tests) and frontend (Playwright) testing of JLT Fragrances MVP. Backend 100% pass (catalog, filters, quiz, discovery sets, contact, reviews, JWT auth, admin CRUD, CSV import). Frontend critical flows all work: Home (8 bestsellers, mood/occasion chips, disclaimer), Shop (24 cards + filters), Product Detail (size selector, add-to-cart, wishlist), Quiz, Discovery Sets, Cart, Admin login → dashboard with product table + CSV import. 791 products auto-seeded from PDF correctly.

minor.issue: Update endpoint accepts ProductUpsert but does not regenerate slug or preserve sizes/base_price/rating; full replacement of those fields could be inconsistent. Not breaking currently.
Fallback only filters by mood when results <3; could surface gender/projection mismatched items. Acceptable behavior but worth noting.

ui_bugs.issue: Login button has data-testid='admin-submit' but lacks type='submit'. Pressing Enter inside email/password field does not submit the form (must click button). Minor UX issue.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' in console — likely a styled <span> inside the sort <select><option>. Should use plain text inside <option>.

action_items: Add type='submit' to admin login button so Enter key submits the form
Remove <span> wrappers inside <option> elements in Shop sort dropdown to fix React hydration warning
(Optional) PUT /api/admin/products/{slug} could $set only provided fields to avoid clobbering sizes/base_price
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 411 lines — acceptable but approaching split threshold; consider extracting auth/admin routers if it grows.
JWT secret is committed in backend/.env (development convenience). For production, rotate via secret manager.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per CORS spec; browsers may reject credentialed requests. Tighten origins for prod.
No rate limiting on /api/auth/login — playbook requested brute-force lockout after 5 fails; currently not implemented.
Admin CRUD uses Bearer JWT in localStorage (XSS exposure). Acceptable for MVP but httpOnly cookies were the playbook recommendation.
Reviews endpoint does not validate product_slug exists before insert.
_id is correctly excluded in all read queries (good).
Product detail related-products query uses $or without index on combined fields — fine at 791 docs.
seed_data_creation: Test inserted TEST_ prefixed contact, review, product, and CSV-imported products — all cleaned up by the CRUD test. One TEST_ contact + one TEST_ review remain in DB as expected (no delete endpoint exposed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_jlt_api.py covers all major endpoints. Admin login data-testids: admin-email-input, admin-password-input, admin-submit. Product card testid: product-card-{slug}. Mood/occasion testids prefixed mood-/occasion-. localStorage key for admin JWT is 'jlt_admin_token'. Brute-force lockout, httpOnly cookies, and CORS-origin tightening from playbook are NOT implemented — flag if main agent asks.
rca_of_admin_login_button: Initial Playwright run used selector button[type='submit'] which returned None because the React JSX renders <button> without explicit type attribute (defaults to 'submit' inside <form> per HTML spec, but Playwright's CSS attribute selector requires the attribute to exist literally). Reusing data-testid='admin-submit' selector succeeded. Recommend adding type='submit' to satisfy both spec compliance and form submission via Enter key (currently not working because the button isn't recognized as a submit button by the browser when missing type, though this is browser-dependent).
